title: John Ternus as CEO could bring ‘bigger acquisitions,’ new product categories: analyst - 9to5Mac
summary: Tim Cook is in his final weeks as Apple CEO, with John Ternus set to take over the top job on September 1. Essentially, BofA believes Ternus will maintain Cook’s legacy of turning Apple into a highly profitable global machine.
